headings.title: Execution and witness requirements for death-prolonging declaration
headings.reviewNote: Covers written execution, signing, dating, and two-witness requirements for declarations directing withholding of death-prolonging procedures.

headings.title: Declarant duty to notify attending physician and record entry
headings.reviewNote: Covers declarant responsibility to notify attending physician and placement of living will declaration into medical records.

headings.title: Sample statutory declaration form and severability
headings.reviewNote: Covers permissible sample statutory declaration form, revocation provision, and severability of specific directions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections (including embedded statutory declaration and revocation form) against archived text: execution/witness requirements, physician notification/medical record filing, and optional form/severability.

headings.title: Revocation of declaration at any time in any manner
headings.reviewNote: Covers declarant right to revoke declaration at any time and in any communicative manner without regard to physical or mental state.

headings.title: Physician duty to record revocation in medical records
headings.reviewNote: Covers attending physician or healthcare provider duty to record revocation in declarant's medical record.

headings.title: Immunity absent actual knowledge or medical record entry
headings.reviewNote: Covers civil and criminal immunity protecting persons failing to act on revocation absent medical record entry or actual knowledge.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: revocation at any time in any manner regardless of condition, medical record entry, and immunity absent record entry or actual knowledge.

headings.title: Unwilling physician duty to effect patient transfer
headings.reviewNote: Covers obligation of attending physician unwilling to honor living will declaration to take reasonable steps to transfer patient.

headings.title: Health care facility policy transfer obligations
headings.reviewNote: Covers healthcare facility duty to effect patient transfer when facility institutional policies preclude complying with declaration.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: reasonable transfer duties for unwilling attending physicians and health care facilities with preclusive policies.

headings.title: Professional discipline for physician failure to honor declaration
headings.reviewNote: Covers classification of failure to honor declaration without serious reason as unprofessional conduct for physicians and providers.

headings.title: Loss of testamentary inheritance rights for acting contrary to wishes
headings.reviewNote: Covers forfeiture of testamentary inheritance rights under declarant's will for acting contrary to patient's expressed intentions.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for concealment or falsification of declaration
headings.reviewNote: Covers classification of willful concealment, destruction, or forging of a declaration or revocation as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Felony penalty for forged declaration causing hastened death
headings.reviewNote: Covers classification of forging declaration or concealing revocation causing withdrawal of treatment and death as class B felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text: unprofessional conduct for disregarding declaration, testamentary inheritance forfeiture, class A misdemeanor concealment/forgery, and class B felony forgery/concealment causing hastened death.

headings.title: Life insurance policies unimpaired by living will declaration
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that executing a declaration or withholding death-prolonging procedures does not impair or invalidate life insurance.

headings.title: Prohibition against requiring declaration as condition for services
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory prohibition barring persons, corporations, or agencies from requiring declarations as conditions for benefits or services.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: non-impairment of life insurance policies and prohibition on requiring declarations as a condition of contracts, services, or benefits.

headings.title: Definitions for Advance Health Care Directives Registry
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory definitions for adult, advance health care directive, declaration, department, health care decision, and intake point.

headings.title: Establishment of central online advance directives registry
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department of health and senior services to issue an RFP and contract with a third party to establish the secure online Advance Health Care Directives Registry; original-rolls footnote notes "proposals" in S.B. 501, 2017.

headings.title: Voluntary submission of directives and revocations by adult declarants
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization for adult declarants to submit advance health care directives, declarations, and revocations to the central registry.

headings.title: Electronic submission at intake points, unique identifier, and fee cap
headings.reviewNote: Covers electronic filing at licensed intake points, unique government identifier signature, and maximum ten-dollar submission fee.

headings.title: Confidentiality and sunshine law exemption for registry data
headings.reviewNote: Covers strict confidentiality of registry data and records and express exemption from public disclosure under chapter 610.

headings.title: Vendor operational responsibilities, education, and user support
headings.reviewNote: Covers contracting vendor responsibilities for registry operation, public education, technical support, and fee collection.

headings.title: Department rulemaking on registry access and annual user reminders
headings.reviewNote: Covers department authority to promulgate rules governing authorized user access and annual document registration reminders.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority under chapter 536 and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Covers administrative rulemaking authority under chapter 536 and legislative disapproval nonseverability clause.

headings.title: Validity of unregistered advance directives and unnotified revocations
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory rule that failure to register a directive or notify registry of revocation does not affect legal validity.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 9 subsections against archived text (noting original-rolls footnote "proposals" in S.B. 501, 2017 in subsection 2): Advance Health Care Directives Registry definitions, third-party online registry, voluntary intake-point submission ($10 cap), confidentiality, vendor duties, rulemaking/nonseverability, and unregistered validity.
